rows.surface: Installation journal identity, private installer evidence and per-app rollback/removal ownership
rows.mechanism: Reddit format-2 installation identity is preserved. Facebook format 3 requires explicit app/source/container/exact bundle, primary and complete versioned groups plus typed recovery flags. Installer and recovery validate the immutable owner before service calls, quiesce that app and preserve original/failed-install snapshots. Removal capture checks the app marker and sandbox metadata; uninstall is limited to its manager descriptor. Validated foreign journals are left to their own app manager; unknown journals remain recovery blockers. Only exactly owned legacy Facebook integer 0/1 flags are admitted for compatibility; recovery durably normalizes them to CFBoolean before any cleanup or replay. Strings, floats and other integers are rejected.
rows.verification: Physical offline Facebook clone installation reproduced rejection of the producer's own numeric hadPreviousInstall flag before appinst. Failing-first tests now extract that actual production expression: Facebook emits CFBoolean, while legacy Reddit bytes remain numeric. 799 actual per-app recovery assertions and 99 inactive / 122 temporary active-Facebook global recovery assertions pass. Both disposable Facebook clones then installed and synchronized on iPhone 8 / iOS 16.7.16. Full 0.1.30 rootless build passed 119 test entrypoints plus the pasteboard API check; seven Mach-O components / twelve slices retain entitlements and license pin. This establishes installation/recovery, not account or network readiness.
rows.fix: Installation/recovery/capture implemented; deletion follows in FBLIFE-002. Other global maintenance, replacement, restored app state and live Facebook/network/MDM acceptance remain pending; registry stays inactive.

rows.mechanism: Long-lived coordinator stops/drains every runnable family before rotation and launches the selected exact app under the existing ARMED gate. Actual readiness waiter with real private files and synthetic PID/service providers: 71 assertions. Failing-first tests reproduced Reddit-only control dispatch and acceptance of future-dated readiness. Existing request cancellation and coordinator/ThreadSanitizer suites retained. The final writer now derives the bundle from its immutable descriptor and checks the profile owner before an OS lookup.
rows.fix: Global launch and gate callers integrated. All-app installation recovery dispatch, replacement, restored state and live Facebook/MDM/network acceptance remain pending; registry and defaults/wire readiness stay inactive.

rows.surface: Complete installation-recovery dispatch and global cloud maintenance closure
rows.mechanism: Preflight the full owner/group-bound installation inventory before effects; unknown owners and pending inactive-app work block recovery. Replay each runnable owner under one counted operation/transaction lock through the existing app-specific method. Migration and CLI provisioning use this entry point; pending deletion suppresses rollback. Cloud snapshot quiescence and active cloud retirement revoke first, then stop/drain every runnable app before acknowledging closure. The legacy assignment-revocation method also establishes CLOSED, stops all app families and verifies socket drain before updating the profile; failure fences recovery.
rows.verification: Actual global dispatcher and migration: 99 production-registry and 122 temporary active-Facebook fixture assertions; real journals/lock, inert services. Underlying actual per-app recovery remains covered by 799 assertions. Actual cloud/retirement closure: 45 assertions with temporary lease files and synthetic gate/coordinator/store. Failing-first cases found Reddit-only migration/stop selection. Exceptions drain lock/work, unknown/partial owners preserve all journals, pending deletion suppresses rollback. tools/test_cloud_assignment_closure.py: 18 assertions execute the actual formerly Reddit-only revocation method, including closure/write failures. This legacy polling method is not activated or scheduled by this change.
rows.fix: Global recovery and these maintenance callers implemented. Replacement and app-specific restored state remain pending. Legacy unscheduled assignment-polling methods are not activated. Live Facebook runtime/MDM/network acceptance is still required.
